title: Vietnam Highlights with FREE Ban Gioc Waterfall Tour
highlights: Get ready to go on a Vietnam adventure, featuring majestic waterfalls, serene bay cruises, and cultural immersions across Hanoi, Halong Bay, and Cao Bang.
Sail through the emerald waters of Halong Bay on an overnight cruise, admiring its iconic limestone formations at Surprise Caves and exploring Ti Top Island.
Witness the breathtaking Ban Gioc Waterfall, one of Vietnam's largest and most spectacular cascades.
Explore Hanoi's rich history and vibrant culture visiting attractions like the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum and the ancient Temple of Literature.

know_before_you_go: Images are for representation purposes only.
Kindly carry a valid photo ID proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as proof of identity.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change during peak season and blackout dates.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your upper arms and legs covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Always carry tissue paper or wet wipes with you as most public toilets in Vietnam do not provide them.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly in Vietnam. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.

As per Indian Govt. rules, a Tax Collection at Source (TCS) of 5% for Foreign Remittance shall be paid additionally that you can claim while filing the income tax returns. Kindly consult a tax advisor/consultant for further information.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Vietnam! Upon arrival at Noi Bai International Airport, transfer to your hotel for check-in. Spend the rest of the day exploring the destination at your own pace. You can visit the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, the resting place of the Vietnamese revolutionary leader Ho Chi Minh, and the Lake of the Restored Sword, a significant cultural and historical site in Hanoi, along with other attractions. After a fun-filled day, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Ninh Binh
days.desc: Today, board your pre-booked transfer from the hotel and get ready to go on the Ninh Binh city tour. Visit the former capital of Vietnam - Hao Lu, and its temples of the Dinh & Le Dynasties. After exploring the temples, board the boat from Hao Lu to Tam Coc, and enjoy a ride through limestone karst (rock formation) landscapes and rice fields, while admiring the caves formed over millions of years. Later, transfer back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Halong Bay | Overnight Halong Bay Cruise
days.desc: Begin your day by checking out of your hotel and embarking on a scenic drive to Halong Bay, passing through the picturesque countryside of Northern Vietnam. Upon arrival at the Tuan Chau Harbour, board your traditional sailing cruise and get ready to enjoy the views of various islets as you sail through the bay. Later, visit the Ti Top Island and Pearl Farm Village by boat and enjoy water activities like kayaking and swimming. After getting back, have an overnight stay on the cruise.

items.desc: 1 X AC Shuttle Bus will be Provided

items.title: Halong Bay Overnight Cruise on a Shared basis
items.desc:
Board the cruise for Halong Bay from Tuan Chao Harbor and check-in into your cabin. Enjoy the scenery while sipping the welcome drink. Reach Tiptop Island and relax. 
Explore Pearl Farm Village by boat and enjoy water activities like Kayaking and swimming in the bay. Return to the cruise. Afterwards, join the cooking classes on Vietnamese-styled food. 
Enjoy the overnight stay at the cruise.

days.title: Transfer to Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Begin your day on a cruise by engaging in a Tai Chi (martial art) lesson. Visit the largest caves of Halong Bay, the Surprise Caves, and witness the cave formations hanging from the ceiling. After lunch, disembark from the cruise and get transferred to Hanoi. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel, and spend the remaining time at leisure by exploring the locality. Later, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Halong Bay to Hanoi
items.desc:
Enjoy your journey by joining the Tai Chi lesson on the cruise. Explore the other parts and islands of the Halong Bay. 
Experience a boat ride to the Surprise Cave, the largest caves in the Halong Bay and admire it's scenic beauty. 
Return to the cruise, relax and enjoy before reaching Taun Chan Bay

days.title: Transfer to Cao Bang | Leisure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out from the hotel and get transferred to Cao Bang. As you reach your hotel in Cao Bang, check in and spend the day at your own pace. You can visit attractions like Angel-Eye Mountain (Núi Mắt Thần) or Pac Bo Cave. After exploring the place, head back to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Ban Gioc Waterfall
days.desc: Start your day by heading for a day trip to Ban Gioc Waterfall on your own. The waterfall is located on the Vietnam-China border, offering a mesmerising experience with a feeling of refreshing water spray on your face. Enjoy a thrilling boat ride on the Quay Son River, and visit Nguom Ngao Cave to explore the unique limestone formations hanging from the ceiling. After a fun-filled day, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Hanoi | Half-Day City Tour
days.desc: Today, check out of the hotel and get transferred to Hanoi. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel and get ready to go on a half-day city tour. Visit attractions such as Ngoc Son Temple, and One Pillar Pagoda. Explore the Temple of Literature, a popular cultural and historical relic in Hanoi. Also, visit Chua Tran Quoc, the oldest Buddhist temple in Hanoi, and Ho Chi Minh Complex, known to be the resting place of leader- Ho Chi Minh. Later, get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.
